does_not_close: Does NOT establish FTO, patentability, procurement, or jurisdictional coverage.

Verifies textual-anchor fidelity of the charted element list against the real published claim only; does not perform a legal claim-construction or infringement analysis, and does not review dependent claims, prosecution history, or equivalents.
A defect found here is a landscape-fixture data-quality/provenance defect, not itself an FTO or infringement determination in either direction.

rows.extracted_claim1_text: 1 . a curable epoxy resin coating composition useful for preparing a coating comprising: (a) at least one epoxy resin; (b) at least one polyamide hardener; and (c) at least one reactive compatibilizer agent having at least one polar functionality; wherein the curable epoxy resin coating composition has a volume solids content of greater than about 70 percent; and wherein the curable epoxy resin coating composition, when cured, shows a value of blooming and blushing from 4 to 5.

a polyamide composition consisting essentially of a polyamide having groups derived from: a diamine selected from the group consisting of ethylene diamine and hexamethylene diamine; a straight chain monocarboxylic acid independently selected from the group consisting of: acetic acid, propionic acid, and combinations thereof; a fatty acid independently selected from the group consisting of: 12-hydroxystearic acid, lesquerolic acid and combinations thereof; wherein the diamine, the straight chain monocarboxylic acid and fatty acid have a molar equivalent ratio ranging from 1:1.75: 0.25 to 1:0.75:1.25; or 1:1.5:0.5 to 1:1:1; and a median particle size ranging from 1 µm to 10 µm.
